summary: An advertisement has run while the committee’s repayment is still outstanding.
realLife: Hicks reported that Terry Moss and Robert Short had covered a newspaper ad and the county party would receive its bill the following month.
inGame: needs: the ad purchase, who advanced the payment and whether the committee has repaid it.

turns.what: The treasurer enters the reimbursement against the ad.
turns.pulledBy: The original payer supplies the invoice.
turns.writesBack: The ledger shows who got the money back.

turns.what: The treasurer identifies the outstanding expense aloud.
turns.pulledBy: The invoice has not arrived by the next report.
turns.writesBack: The advance stays open under the original payer’s name.
